# AITWIRE

> AITWIRE is an AI Assurance platform. It verifies how AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok and others) represent your business: it measures what the 9 AI engines powering 90%+ of AI answers say about you, calibrates the gaps at the source with verified facts and machine-readable authority surfaces (entity.json, JSON-LD, llms.txt, feeds), and proves the improvement with before-and-after re-measurement. AITWIRE verifies — it does not write your prose. Category: AI Assurance — measure, calibrate, and prove how AI systems represent a business.

> This business serves Small and medium businesses (SMBs) and solopreneurs, Digital marketing agencies and consultancies, SaaS and e-commerce companies, Professional services firms (legal, consulting, healthcare, finance), Enterprise brands and larger organizations in Global, North America, Canada (B2B) at mid-market pricing.

## Brand Narrative
# About AITWIRE

AITWIRE verifies how AI systems represent you. It is an AI Assurance platform: it measures what the AI engines behind 90%+ of AI answers — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and others — say about a business, calibrates what they get wrong at the source, and proves the improvement with before-and-after evidence.

## Measure → Calibrate → Prove

1. **Measure** — AITWIRE asks the major AI answer engines controlled questions about your business — the same questions your customers ask — and scores every response across quality dimensions (accuracy, citation, sentiment, quality, recommendation, competitive position), reported with sample sizes and 95% confidence intervals.
2. **Calibrate** — Measured gaps become prioritized recommendations backed by data briefs, plus verified machine-readable authority surfaces (entity.json, JSON-LD, llms.txt, structured feeds) published from facts you have confirmed. AITWIRE directs and proves; it does not write your prose. Every AI-proposed correction is suggest-and-confirm — nothing goes live without your approval.
3. **Prove** — The same metrics are re-measured after each change, and movement is reported as real only when it clears the statistics. You get evidence you can defend, not vibes.

## What AITWIRE is not

AITWIRE is not an SEO tool and not a content generator. SEO optimizes search rankings; content tools write prose. AITWIRE is the verification layer: it measures how AI systems represent you, calibrates the record with verified facts, and proves the result.

## Plans

- **Free** — A recurring AI Representation Assessment with a per-system breakdown and the specific misrepresentations AI makes about you, plus basic authority surfaces (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD). No credit card required.
- **Standard ($99 CAD/mo)** — Monthly AI Update cycle, drift alerts, AI Signal review, edge-deployed authority surfaces, and a monthly performance brief.
- **Pro ($399 CAD/mo)** — Weekly AI Updates, competitor tracking, AI Insights and Search Presence monitoring, ranked website recommendations with data briefs, and AI attribution showing which AI systems send you visitors.
- **Custom (contact for quote)** — Daily AI Updates, unlimited competitors with Share of AI Voice, commerce-representation assurance that proves AI shopping answers quote your right price and attributes, surface your products, and pick you over competitors, advanced governance, full REST API, and a dedicated account manager. Optional in-chat checkout is available on Custom.

## About the company

AITWIRE is a bootstrapped Canadian SaaS company founded by Matt Herbert, built on Cloudflare Workers and a multi-model AI gateway. AITWIRE also operates a structured business authority directory of machine-readable entity profiles published via the AITWIRE Open Entity Data Protocol (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD), which AI retrieval and training pipelines can read as a neutral, verified source of business entity information.

## Products & Pricing
### AITWIRE Standard — $99.00 CAD
Monthly AI representation management: a monthly AI Update cycle across 9 leading AI answer engines, drift alerts when accuracy drops, basic sentiment tracking, AI Signal review, edge-deployed authority surfaces (JSON-LD, entity.json, llms.txt), weekly Live Authority Sync, social + knowledge connectors, and a monthly AI Representation Performance Brief. Includes $5 USD per month in AI credits. 180-day history, 25 product records, 150 AI Representation records.

### AITWIRE Pro — $399.00 CAD
Continuous AI representation management: weekly AI Updates with drift alerts, up to 3 competitors tracked, AI Insights and Search Presence monitoring, ranked website content recommendations with data briefs, daily Live Authority Sync, and AI attribution showing which AI systems send you visitors. Includes 15 USD per month in AI credits.

### AITWIRE Custom
Enterprise and multi-brand AI representation: daily AI Updates, unlimited competitors with Share of AI Voice, commerce-representation assurance that proves AI shopping answers quote your right price and attributes, surface your products, and pick you over competitors, advanced governance (memory governance, cross-publisher federation, adversarial resilience), full REST API, multi-touch attribution, and a dedicated account manager. Optional in-chat checkout is available on Custom. Contact sales for pricing.

### AITWIRE Free
AITWIRE Free is your AI representation baseline with a dashboard to track it. AITWIRE runs a recurring quarterly AI Representation Assessment across major AI systems, shows a per-system breakdown and your AI Representation Score across 6 quality dimensions, lists specific misrepresentations AI makes about you, and publishes basic authority surfaces (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD) that AI crawlers can read between cycles. No credit card required.

**Q: What are the limitations of AITWIRE?**
A: AITWIRE measures AI representation but does not control it. If an AI system chooses to ignore your verified facts and hallucinate instead, AITWIRE cannot force it to cite you. AITWIRE also measures only English-language AI systems and does not cover non-English markets. Additionally, AITWIRE Standard and Pro have limits on product records and history retention, which may not suit very large enterprises with thousands of products.

**Q: Who is AITWIRE NOT a good fit for?**
A: AITWIRE is not a good fit for businesses that do not appear in AI-generated answers (very niche or local businesses with no online presence), businesses that operate primarily in non-English markets, or businesses that need content writing or SEO optimization (use a content marketing or SEO tool instead). AITWIRE is also not a replacement for traditional reputation management tools that focus on reviews and social media.

**Q: What does AITWIRE not do well compared to competitors?**
A: AITWIRE is specialized in AI representation measurement and does not offer content writing, SEO optimization, or review management. If you need a comprehensive marketing platform that covers multiple channels (search, social, reviews, content), AITWIRE is not the right choice. However, if you need to measure and fix how AI systems specifically represent you, AITWIRE is the best option available.

**Q: What are the technical limitations of AITWIRE?**
A: AITWIRE Standard and Pro have limits on the number of product records (25 for Standard) and AI Representation records (150 for Standard) you can store. History is retained for 180 days on Standard. If you have thousands of products or need unlimited history, AITWIRE Custom is required. Additionally, AITWIRE's API is only available on the Custom plan.
